name: EverNest Atlas
intents: build me a 30 60 90 day life plan
help me think through relocation and housing stability
compare practical life paths for my family
plan a career change around my household situation
turn my income savings debt skills and priorities into a life plan
help me organize housing career income and family systems together
create a relocation career and family stability roadmap
give me realistic tradeoffs and backup plans for a major life change
help me plan for stability without pretending outcomes are guaranteed
authority: public discovery plus private account-bound adult life planning from user-supplied inputs
boundaries: generated plans are guidance rather than guaranteed outcomes
cost-of-living, income, timing, housing and career projections are estimates
not financial, legal, medical, tax, housing, safety or professional career advice
private household, financial, career, values, location, stress, plan and account data are not public discovery data
displayed subscription tiers or prices are not proof that billing or entitlement is active
paid access requires successful provider checkout and verified subscription state

evernest.name: EverNest
evernest.description: EverNest handles practical family support and trusted-circle coordination; Atlas handles integrated adult life planning.

revenue-war-map.description: Use Revenue War Map when the user's primary need is focused income-generation planning rather than a broader life roadmap.
